# Junior Thuram Nana — Software Engineer, System Architect & OffSec Expert (Cameroon)

> Cameroonian software engineer, system architect, full-stack developer and offensive-security expert based in **Buea, South-West Region, Cameroon**. Solo architect and developer of record on sovereign-grade national infrastructure for Cameroon — anti-corruption intelligence (VIGIL APEX), beneficial-ownership registry (RÉCOR), maternal-health coordination (MAMA), EUDR compliance (TraceCMR), investigative intelligence (Pattern), and the ANTIC sovereign cyber platform. Vulnerability researcher with disclosures at Meta/WhatsApp and Samsung. Architect of FLAIRE (AI EdTech), BlockEarth (decentralised Web3), and GUC / Got U Connected — the Flutter / Dart student & staff platform of RHIBMS Buea. Delivers nation-scale platforms via disciplined agentic AI engineering under a human architect of record.

## Sovereign National Infrastructure (Cameroon)
- [VIGIL APEX](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): real-time public finance compliance and anti-corruption intelligence platform for CONAC — 26 public data sources, 43 deterministic fraud patterns, Bayesian certainty engine, 3-of-5 hardware-key council quorum, triple-witness audit chain (Postgres + Polygon mainnet + Hyperledger Fabric)
- [RÉCOR](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): national beneficial ownership registry (FATF R.24 / R.25) for the BUNEC / ARMP / ANIF / DGI / BEAC consortium — Rust + TypeScript, 9-stage adversarial verification pipeline, Ed25519 browser-signed declarations, SLSA Level 3, 24 binding engineering doctrines
- [MAMA](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): sovereign maternal and neonatal mobilization architecture for Cameroon — Apache 2.0, offline-first, eight architectural planes against twelve binding doctrines, seven connectivity tiers (T1 fibre → T7 paper-of-record), V-Model discipline
- [TraceCMR](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): sovereign EUDR compliance platform (EU 2023/1115) for MINFOF / MINADER — 10 Hyperledger Fabric chaincodes, FROST-Ed25519 threshold signing, Halo2 zero-knowledge, SLSA Level 4, co-financed by EU / GIZ / World Bank / AFD / FAO / AfDB
- [Pattern](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): classified-aware investigative indexing and analytics platform — Flask + React, FollowTheMoney fragments, content-addressed Archive, bilingual FR/EN, FROST + Halo2 cryptographic roadmap, MIT licensed
- [ANTIC](https://thuramnana.com/#infrastructure): sovereign cyber platform for the Agence Nationale des TIC du Cameroun — agent-orchestrated build harness driving Claude Code (Opus 4.7) subagents against six volumes (~665 pages) of architectural specification toward a day-180 milestone
